records.name: Philly JS Club
records.summary: Philadelphia developers who work with JavaScript and the web. Most months they meet at Indy Hall for short talks, hack nights, and project showcases.
records.what_you_do: Listen to talks on web tools and frameworks, bring a project to a hack night, show what you built, and meet other developers.

schedule.text: About once a month at Indy Hall, most often on a Thursday. The events page lists the dates.

cost.text: The events page does not list a cost

first_step.how: Fill in the sign-up form linked from the Join Us page (the link is labeled Slack), or come to a public meeting at Indy Hall
first_step.basis: Meetings are posted with open dates and the Join Us page has a sign-up link, but the page does not say what the form asks

records.notes: Events list came from the events page: 58 events from June 2022 to Sept 2026, most at Indy Hall. The page gives no street address, so the location has only the venue name. The Join Us sign-up is a Google Form labeled Slack; the form was not opened. Lead came from g2-making-tech (w3-interests-e).

records.name: OWASP King of Prussia
records.notes: The chapter page shows only its title, which names King of Prussia (outside Philadelphia). It gives no meeting place, schedule or contact. Verdict rests on the name alone; recheck if the chapter says it meets in Philadelphia.

records.name: BSides Philadelphia
records.notes: Annual cybersecurity conference (page title: BSides Philadelphia 2026), not a standing group, so not published. The page showed no dates, venue, cost or volunteer sign-up. Recheck next year if it posts a volunteer call.

records.name: JawnCon
records.notes: Annual conference, fourth edition (0x3), listed for Oct 16 to 18, 2026 at Arcadia University. Not a standing group, so not published. Tickets and volunteer sign-up open Aug 1, 2026 per the site. The page does not name the venue's city.

records.name: Pumpcon
records.notes: Conference, not a standing group. The domain now answers with a redirect (301) to a domain resale listing, so the conference's own site is gone. The redirect was not followed. No Philadelphia dates or details found.

notes: 15 leads checked. 1 of 1 WebSearch used, on the Montgomery County Woodworkers Guild lead; it returned only undated forum posts and an old Yahoo group, so no record. 18 fetch calls. Not followed: the Google Forms sign-up link on the Philly JS Club Join Us page, and the Pumpcon redirect.
